public_rationale: The generalization warning has empirical support: tested neural networks can learn a task yet fail systematic recombinations, and later critiques identify continuing limits. The categorical division is too broad, however. Neural meta-learning has produced systematic generalization in controlled comparisons, while symbolic inductive logic programming can learn rules efficiently from examples. These results qualify both halves of the slogan without establishing that either family is generally superior.
limitations: Results depend strongly on task, training distribution, architecture, and supplied background knowledge.
